newsitem.title: USA: Jet fuel in USG firms as it is bought for storage.
newsitem.headline: Jet fuel in USG firms as it is bought for storage.

text.p: Low sulphur jet fuel was offered in the U.S. Gulf at even to NYMEX July heating oil futures on Thursday after being offered below the futures' prices earlier in the week, dealers said.
A contango in the futures spread provided an incentive to store the petroleum product and sell it at the more expensive price that it has acquired from the later contracts.

Contango means the contract nearest in time is less expensive than the later one. July heating oil settled 0.10 cent higher at 51.62 cents a gallon, giving it a 0.68 cent contango to the August contract.
"The heating oil contango is making guys want to buy it and store it," said a U.S. Gulf jet fuel dealer of the prompt low sulphur grade. The 54 grade was bid at 0.25 cent below July heat.

Dealers said prompt 55-grade low sulphur jet should usually trade at a 0.40 to 0.50 cent premium to prompt airline quality jet fuel which was bid at 0.50 cent under July heat, in line with Wednesday's values.
New York Harbor jet fuel, meanhile, was also offered in line with Wednesday's values. The 54 grade was offered at 1.50 cents over July heat.
